parameters.text:
=Perform a comprehensive CRO audit on this page and provide specific, actionable improvements.

Page URL: {{ $('Set Audit Config').item.json.page_url }}
Page Type: {{ $('Set Audit Config').item.json.page_type }}
Current CVR: {{ $('Set Audit Config').item.json.current_cvr }}%
Industry: {{ $('Set Audit Config').item.json.industry }}
Goal: {{ $('Set Audit Config').item.json.goal }}

Page Content:
{{ $('Fetch Page Content').item.json.data?.substring(0,4000) }}

Industry Benchmarks & Best Practices:
{{ $('Research Benchmarks').item.json.choices[0].message.content }}

Audit for:
1. Headline clarity and value proposition
2. Call-to-action strength and placement
3. Trust signals and social proof
4. Page load and friction
5. Mobile optimization signals
6. Above-the-fold optimization
7. Form friction
8. Urgency and scarcity elements

Return JSON:
{
  "current_cvr": 0,
  "industry_benchmark": "",
  "cvr_gap": "",
  "critical_issues": [{"issue": "", "impact": "high/medium", "fix": "", "effort": "quick/medium/major"}],
  "quick_wins": [],
  "headline_analysis": {"current": "", "problem": "", "suggested": ""},
  "cta_analysis": {"current": "", "problem": "", "suggested": ""},
  "trust_signals_missing": [],
  "priority_test_list": [],
  "estimated_cvr_improvement": "",
  "audit_summary": "3-4 sentence plain English summary"
}

parameters.content:
## FLOOWBOX - CRO Optimizer Agent
Send any page URL + current CVR + industry.
Jina AI fetches full page content.
Perplexity researches industry benchmarks + best practices.
GPT-4o audits 8 CRO dimensions:
Headline, CTA, trust signals, friction, mobile, ATF, forms, urgency.
Outputs: critical issues, quick wins, headline/CTA rewrites, test list.
Saves to Notion + Slack.
